# W22 (ED-NEW-web-w22-3): English-looking literals in the web user-interface source that stay in code on purpose, "file TAB text" (the text as written
# between the quotes). They are CSS and layout strings, ids and glyph names, brand names that stand alone, key chords, file-type names, log lines,
# exception messages, and text for the model or for a page. A word a person reads belongs in src/Marrow.Core/Localisation/Strings, not here.
